question: List all customers from Brazil
sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName, Email FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

question: How many customers does each country have?
sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(Country) as CustomerCount FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC

question: What is the total sales revenue per country?
sql: SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) as TotalSales FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry

question: What is the average invoice total per country?
sql: SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) as AvgOrderValue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY AvgOrderValue DESC

question: What are the top 5 longest tracks in minutes?
sql: SELECT Name, ROUND(Milliseconds / 60000.0, 2) as Minutes FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 5

question: What was the best single month for revenue ever?
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) as YearMonth, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) as Revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY YearMonth ORDER BY Revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the total revenue per month across all years?
sql: SELECT strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) as Month, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) as Revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY Month ORDER BY Month

question: Which customers have made more than 5 purchases?
sql: SELECT FirstName || ' ' || LastName as Customer, COUNT(i.InvoiceId) as Purchases FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId HAVING Purchases > 5 ORDER BY Purchases DESC

question: Which employees support the most customers?
sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName as EmpName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) as NumCustomers FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY NumCustomers DESC

question: List all albums with their artist names sorted alphabetically by artist
sql: SELECT al.Title as Album, ar.Name as Artist FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId ORDER BY ar.Name

question: What are the top 10 best selling tracks by quantity sold?
sql: SELECT t.Name, SUM(il.Quantity) as TotalSold FROM Track t JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY t.TrackId ORDER BY TotalSold DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which sales rep generated the most revenue from their customers?
sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName as SalesRep, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) as TotalCustomerSpend FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY TotalCustomerSpend DESC

question: What is the average revenue per customer by country?
sql: SELECT Country, ROUND(AVG(CustomerTotal), 2) as AvgRevenuePerCustomer FROM (SELECT c.Country, SUM(i.Total) as CustomerTotal FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId) GROUP BY Country ORDER BY AvgRevenuePerCustomer DESC

question: Who is the top spending customer in each country?
sql: SELECT Country, CustomerName, TotalSpent FROM (SELECT c.Country, c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName as CustomerName, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) as TotalSpent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.Country ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC) as rn FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY Country

question: How many tracks does each genre have?
sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) as TrackCount FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY TrackCount DESC

question: Which customers spent more than the average customer spending?
sql: SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName as CustomerName, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) as TotalSpent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId HAVING SUM(i.Total) > (SELECT AVG(CustomerTotal) FROM (SELECT SUM(Total) as CustomerTotal FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId)) ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC

question: Which genre generates the most revenue?
sql: SELECT g.Name, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) as Revenue FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY Revenue DESC

question: Which artist generated the highest total revenue?
sql: SELECT ar.Name, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) as TotalRevenue FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the revenue ranking of all artists?
sql: SELECT ar.Name, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) as TotalRevenue FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC

question: Which genre has the most tracks sold?
sql: SELECT g.Name, SUM(il.Quantity) as TotalQuantitySold FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY TotalQuantitySold DESC LIMIT 1
